integration.name: SendGrid
integration.summary: A mail API you can reach with a restricted key. SendGrid returns the message id in a response header, and that id is what the send log stores.

credentials.label: API Key
credentials.note: A restricted key with permission to send mail.

config.label: Sender address (From)
config.note: Must be an address on a domain you have verified in SendGrid.

strengths: Restricted keys, so sending can be granted without granting account access
A conventional mail API surface and error vocabulary
Domain verification stays in your own SendGrid account
considerations: The message id comes back in the X-Message-Id response header; a 2xx without one is treated as a failed send rather than a success.
